status: source review only; no passenger runtime enabled and no completed port claimed
evidence_method: Bounded disassembly of the installed executable, exact API registrations and pinned local XML/wiki records. This is not recovered source or a dynamic trace of Isaac.

findings.claim: Effect1000.152 dispatches to0x4a9240. The effect constructor uniquely matches the pinned signature; its vtable Update slot points to0x5bdf00. The variant-1 table at0x5e9214 maps152 to0x5c3090, which calls the controller.
Initialization calls the rail setup helper0x4a3fb0, sets state1, and assigns Timeout and LifeSpan to150+(globalRNG%210), inclusive150..359. Initialization does not halve this delay in large rooms.

The common effect epilogue decrements a positive Timeout by one and sets byte0x16b when it reaches zero. The controller reads that byte on a later update. Thus it is a timeout latch here, not an NPC death-only flag. Preserve this update order.

Passenger attempts require max(0,room[0x12c8]+room[0x12cc])>0. The installed GetAliveBossesCount registration/getter verifies that this means living bosses, not all enemies. No independent numeric passenger-count cap is present in this bounded controller; available paired doors limit admission.

When the room-clear bit is set, the controller calls cleanup0x4a48b0 and removes itself. Installed IsClear verifies descriptor+0x44 bit0. The controller does not equate boss disappearance with immediate cleanup of every payload.

The picker considers type967 doors whose reservation pointer is null and whose paired door is also unreserved. During the initial room-entry grace it excludes squared distance<=3600 native units from the entry location. It chooses one available door using globalRNG modulo candidate count. A zero rail direction rejects the attempt.

The payload index is globalRNG%7. Exact ordered(type,variant) pairs are(823,0),(820,0),(827,0),(227,0),(87,0),(33,0),(292,0), all subtype0. Six pairs come from three constant blocks; the final pair is constructed by immediate instructions. No weighting/duplication appears in this table.

The factory creates the selected NPC with subtype0 and no spawner entity, clears flag mask0x4, then sets SpawnerType906. Installed SpawnerType getter verifies offset0x34. This alone is not a live Parent or lifetime ownership link to the Hornfel actor.

The attachment helper creates type965 variant0, initializes drive1, sets position/velocity from the selected door, and links rider[0x32c] with cart[0x318]. Door reservation then references the rider from both paired endpoints. Rider and carrier are separate entities.

After every elapsed attempt, including no available door or invalid direction, the controller draws a new150..359 delay, clears the timeout latch, and sets both Timeout and LifeSpan. For room grid width*height>135 it uses integer division by2, yielding75..179. It does not immediately retry a blocked route each frame.

Ordinary cart AI removes a non-Hornfel rider and the carrier after the out-of-room test; the real906.0 rider is exempt from this ordinary exit branch. A cart without a rider increments a counter and breaks after it exceeds2. A passenger must therefore distinguish leaving/removal from gameplay death and loot.

Installed Lua Remove and Kill registrations dispatch to virtual offsets0x28 and0x24 respectively. Cart exit and room cleanup use Remove, not Kill; the distinction is established independently of newer structure declarations.

Room-clear cleanup collects967 doors and all entities with a cart pointer. It creates poof effects and removes each carried entity plus its carrier; it also removes the doors. Free Fly Bomb escorts are not selected solely for having a former Hornfel parent.

Movable TNT uses a special incoming-damage accumulator: ordinary positive damage causes one or two HP units of loss with a1/3 extra-unit draw; explosion flag mask0x4 uses four, clamped at1. A mounted destroyed TNT is removed, whereas a non-mounted TNT leaves an inert low-HP state. These are preflight findings, not a complete damage/contact/loot audit.

Normal fireplace damage is processed per queued hit, with an extra1/3 unit and a higher base above damage10; extinguishing disables collision and changes state. The mounted case bypasses fixed grid updates. Native5HP is therefore not a justification for ordinary linear5x3.2HP damage. Reward/status/flooding variants remain a separate audit.

timing_contract.attempt_gate: timeout latch AND at least one alive boss; candidate door and nonzero rail direction required for actual spawning

timing_contract.normal_time_adaptation_if_30hz: 150..359 counts correspond to5..11.9667 seconds;75..179 correspond to2.5..5.9667. This conversion remains an explicit local adaptation until update cadence is measured.

uncertainties: Five creature AI dispatch targets are identified, but their full native movement/attack/damage functions have not been reviewed by this pass.
Rider position/velocity override order within the common entity/physics pipeline is unresolved; do not freeze every passenger AI while mounted.
The general NPC damage callback, mounted damage eligibility, exact fire/TNT reward logic and player/item/status exceptions need review before shipping payloads.
Door opening/closing timing, reservation release after deferred removals, global RNG phase and engine update cadence are not reproduced by this source-only report.
Room-clear cleanup may expose differences in the current decoy completion adaptation; test boss removal, surviving escorts and all rider types together.
Existing source-stage hints map to DeathWard floor bands, not a replacement of the4-8floor expedition structure or the Mine roster.
